slice: P4 selected AC1018 BLOCK/ENDBLK source endpoints
scope: Private source-only endpoint proof for the selected same-import AC1018 INSERT compound. An authenticated source relation and unique original BLOCK_RECORD name under the selected ASCII policy precede a bounded original BLOCKS-section endpoint census.

contract.operation: Count and frame BLOCK/ENDBLK pairs in the single source BLOCKS section, require unique selected-name and selected-owner agreement, self and owner handle identities, subclass roles and mutually agreeing group-2/group-3 BLOCK names; publish both endpoints only after success. Each endpoint uses its observed one repeated self admission for this raw-plus-typed capture route.
contract.resource: Prior name uniqueness uses one half of work and retained-byte limits; separate relation and endpoint scans each use one quarter. Failure or quota exhaustion publishes no endpoints.
contract.unqualified: Native collation, block child completeness or content meaning, live graph, geometry, export and general support.

validation.focusedControls: Generated ASCII/binary tests include selected BLOCK with an ordinary LINE child and unrelated BLOCK/ENDBLK pairs before and after it; modified names, owners, missing or duplicate endpoints, competing names/owners, context substitutions, work/byte boundaries and same-adapter fresh-data retries. Mutations are route-level no-endpoint evidence; the import or an earlier gate may reject before reaching this census. Child presence exercises framing only and does not qualify child completeness or meaning.
validation.chronology: Final shared normal/ASan tests passed and independent original/changed probes were refreshed against the rebuilt shared normal adapter/library.

independentPeer.derivation: Locally change only the BLOCK 6F4 group-2 name from MyBlock to OtherBlock.
independentPeer.observations: Independent pre-setup physical projection finds BLOCK_RECORD 6F2 and INSERT 704 name MyBlock, BLOCK 6F4 owned by 6F2 with group 2/3 MyBlock, and ENDBLK 6F9 owned by 6F2. The locally changed BLOCK group 2 differs while group 3 and other selected records remain unchanged. The shared-linked probe returns endpoints only for original; earlier relation, unique-name, APPID and LAYER source checks remain true for both.

limitations: Matching uses an explicitly admitted printable-ASCII policy and does not certify native name collation.
The selected endpoint proof does not qualify complete block children, geometry, document graph, XDICTIONARY or regenerated output.
